title: Check the harness before you put it on
lines: Before you put on a harness, inspect it.
Is it in date? Are the labels readable?
No tears, wear or open stitching?
Do the buckles and carabiners close properly?
Anything look wrong? Don't use it.
Your harness protects you, so look after it.
Tal's daily tip. Ofek At Tal Cranes.
